train_ACL_model: train an ACL continual learning model on a task dataset with adversarial discriminator training
evaluate_ACL_model: evaluate an ACL model on a data loader and return task accuracy and loss metrics
test_ACL_model: test an ACL model on a data loader and return accuracy and loss results
run_ACL_inference: run inference with an ACL model on a data loader and return task accuracy and loss
compute_DiffLoss: compute the difference loss between two feature tensors using L2 normalized cosine similarity
